program.merge_policy: accumulate twenty 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after Wave 1000

source_provenance: PubMed sleep/anxiety, menopause, bone-health and nausea systematic-review literature

policy.validation_strategy: cheap PMID/entity screening during authoring; full repository validation only after Wave 1000

waves.focus: Five-RCT/400-participant sleep meta-analysis; small pooled sleep benefit with stronger subgroup signals in insomnia/longer exposure, but extract/duration heterogeneity and no generic dose recommendation.
22-RCT aromatherapy meta-analysis; anxiety and selected physiologic stress signals, with route-specific evidence and substantial contextual heterogeneity.
Nine-trial cognition meta-analysis; attention-processing-speed signals with standardized-extract and chronic-use boundaries, not proof of broad nootropic enhancement.
2025/2026 review of 11 RCTs/628 adults; lavender essential oil improved pooled sleep-quality scores, but route, blinding and subjective-outcome limits remain.
Systematic review of randomized trials for menopausal vasomotor symptoms; inconsistent results and study-quality variation prevent a uniform hot-flash claim.
Updated 22-study/2,310-participant meta-analysis; overall menopausal/hot-flash signals with anxiety/depression nulls and combination-regimen heterogeneity.
11-RCT menopause meta-analysis; estradiol/Kupperman signals with hot-flash/FSH/LH nulls and extreme heterogeneity.
Older placebo-controlled meta-analysis suggesting vasomotor improvement but with significant heterogeneity; retained as historical positive evidence.
2025 six-RCT menopause systematic review/meta-analysis; menopausal-symptom evidence remains limited and indication/formulation specific.
GRADE-assessed hot-flash systematic review/meta-analysis; red-clover isoflavone efficacy remains formulation/population specific.
Cochrane review of 16 RCTs/2,027 women; no significant difference versus placebo for hot-flush frequency or menopausal symptom scores, a major counterweight to positive syntheses.
Older systematic review of six double-blind RCTs; efficacy inconsistent and uncertain, supporting explicit historical disagreement.
Eight-trial meta-analysis; modest reduction in daily hot-flash frequency with substantial heterogeneity and formulation/dose dependence.
Review/meta-analysis of isopropanolic Cimicifuga racemosa extract; product-specific menopausal evidence with manufacturer-affiliation provenance retained.
2019 CINV systematic review/meta-analysis; selected acute-vomiting/fatigue signals but many nausea/delayed outcomes null, adjunctive oncology context only.
2022 review of 23 CINV RCTs; overall acute/delayed nausea/vomiting largely null, with a limited low-dose/longer-duration acute-vomiting subgroup signal.
Ten-RCT CINV meta-analysis; historical pooled antiemetic evidence retained alongside newer conflicting syntheses.
14-study postoperative-nausea/vomiting meta-analysis; selected nausea/rescue-antiemetic outcomes improved while vomiting comparisons were mixed.
RCT meta-analysis in menopausal women; spine BMD signal with intervention-duration, geography, dose and preparation heterogeneity.
Four-RCT menopause systematic review; limited favorable symptom evidence with small samples, methodological limitations and insufficient safety evidence.
18-RCT meta-analysis; modest BMD preservation at lumbar spine/femoral neck/hip with preparation, duration and population modifiers.
Bone-turnover-marker meta-analysis in postmenopausal women; osteocalcin/BAP/PYD/DPD pooled changes were not statistically significant.
2024 umbrella review of ten RCT meta-analyses; BMD signals across several bone sites, but inherits heterogeneity and quality limits of underlying reviews.
Meta-analysis in Western peri/postmenopausal women; isoflavone mixtures did not significantly preserve lumbar-spine BMD, useful counterweight to broader positive syntheses.
63-RCT postmenopausal BMD meta-analysis; pooled bone-density signals with major intervention, duration and population heterogeneity.
